subject: general
question: What is the name of the ChatGPT-style AI service set to be launched by Reliance Industries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hanooman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reliance Industries Limited (RIL)**, in partnership with the **BharatGPT group**, is set to launch a series of **Large Language Models (LLMs)** called **Hanooman**.
 
• The **Hanooman** AI service is designed as a **ChatGPT-style** multimodal AI tool that can communicate in more than **11 Indian languages**, including **Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, and Marathi**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Hanooman.***
 
• This initiative is a collaborative effort between **Jio Platforms**, the **Department of Science and Technology**, and eight **Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs)**, with **IIT Bombay** playing a leading role.
 
• The AI model is specifically tailored to provide solutions in four critical sectors: **Healthcare, Governance, Financial Services, and Education**.
 
• Unlike global models, **Hanooman** aims to solve the unique challenges of the **Indian landscape** by offering **speech-to-text** capabilities in local dialects, catering to a vast population that may not be proficient in English or formal script.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **BharatGPT Consortium:** This is a unique public-private partnership led by **IIT Bombay**. It represents India's effort to create **indigenous AI** that reflects the country's linguistic and cultural diversity.
 
• **Seetha Mahalaxmi Healthcare (SML):** This is the **AI startup** that worked alongside the **BharatGPT** group to develop the **Hanooman** series of models.
 
• **Integration with Jio:** Reliance plans to integrate these **AI capabilities** into its **Jio ecosystem**, potentially powering services like **Jio Brain**, which aims to use AI for better data management and customer service across its telecom and retail arms.
 
• **Competitors:** While **Hanooman** is a localized model, it enters a space currently dominated by global players like **OpenAI (ChatGPT)**, **Google (Gemini)**, and other Indian initiatives like **Krutrim** by Ola and **Airavata**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Technical Scale:** The **Hanooman** series will include models of varying sizes, ranging from **1.5 billion** to **40 billion parameters**, allowing for flexibility in different use cases from mobile apps to heavy enterprise servers.
 
• **Launch Context:** The first set of models was showcased at a technology conference in **Mumbai** in **February 2024**, highlighting India's push for **"Sovereign AI"**.
 
• **Open Source Potential:** There are discussions regarding making parts of the **Hanooman** stack **open-source** to encourage developers in India to build localized applications on top of the base model.
 
• **Multimodality:** The model is **multimodal**, meaning it can process and generate not just **text**, but also **voice, images, and videos**, which is crucial for a country with diverse literacy levels.
